title: Operational digital twin clinics enable task-based evaluation of embodied AI
abstract: arXiv:2608.21416v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied artificial intelligence (AI) must be tested in the clinical environments where it will operate, but building realistic, robot-testable settings is costly and difficult to scale. Here we show that routine clinic images can be transformed into operational digital twins for task-based evaluation of embodied AI. Using 39 ophthalmic clinic scenes, we converted single photographs into editable, simulator-ready environments and assessed reconstruction quality, room-scale geometry, mesh grounding, multi-robot feasibility, perturbation sensitivity and closed-loop policy performance. The reconstructed scenes preserved workspace structure, while local editing enabled controlled device reconfiguration. Device meshes, collision proxies and semantic anchors converted visual reconstructions into contact-aware simulation scenes. translated_title: 运营数字孪生诊所实现具身AI的任务导向评估
translated_abstract: 具身人工智能（AI）必须在其将要运行的临床环境中进行测试，但构建逼真的、可测试机器人的设置成本高昂且难以扩展。在此，我们展示了常规诊所图像可以转化为运营数字孪生，用于具身AI的任务导向评估。利用39个眼科诊所场景，我们将单张照片转换为可编辑的、模拟器就绪的环境，并评估了重建质量、房间级几何结构、网格接地、多机器人可行性、扰动敏感性和闭环策略性能。重建场景保留了工作空间结构，而局部编辑实现了受控的设备重新配置。设备网格、碰撞代理和语义锚点将视觉重建转换为接触感知的模拟场景。在三种机器人形态中，共享任务目标展示了不同的可达性和接触可行性模式。
tldr: 本研究提出将常规诊所照片转化为运营数字孪生，为具身AI提供低成本、可扩展的任务导向评估方法，并验证了其在多机器人场景中的有效性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes transforming routine clinic photos into operational digital twins for low-cost, scalable task-based evaluation of embodied AI, validated across multi-robot scenarios.
